newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Elang Realty active on rights issue talk.
newsitem.headline: Elang Realty active on rights issue talk.

text.p: Indonesian small-sized property firm PT Elang Realty rose in active late trading on Tuesday on market talk of a possible rights issue, brokers said.
Elang rose 8.11 percent, or 75 rupiah, to 1,000 rupiah, with volume approaching 36 million shares.
"Market talk that the firm is likely to announce a rights issue in the near-term prompted local speculative buying at spectacular trading volumes," one broker said.
One property analyst said the extent of the trading volume could be gauged by the fact that the firm offered only 110 million shares at its initial public offering in October 1995.
The analyst said the firm had not published its 1996 net profits, but said it booked a net profit of 2.65 billion rupiah in 1995 against 1.95 billion rupiah in 1994.
Elang officials were not immediately available for comment on the rights issue rumours.
